task: 从业务数据库查询 2025 年销售额最高的 5 个药品，返回药品通用名、销售额和销量。
gold_sql: SELECT d.generic_name, SUM(s.total_amount) AS revenue, SUM(s.quantity_sold) AS quantity FROM drugs d JOIN sales_records s ON d.drug_id = s.drug_id GROUP BY d.drug_id, d.generic_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

task: 查询各销售区域 2025 年总销售额，并按销售额从高到低排序。
gold_sql: SELECT region, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM sales_records GROUP BY region ORDER BY revenue DESC;

task: 找出库存总量最高的 10 个药品，输出通用名、治疗领域和总库存。
gold_sql: SELECT d.generic_name, d.therapeutic_area, SUM(i.quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory FROM drugs d JOIN inventory i ON d.drug_id = i.drug_id GROUP BY d.drug_id, d.generic_name, d.therapeutic_area ORDER BY total_inventory DESC LIMIT 10;

task: 查询有效期在 2027 年 6 月 30 日之前到期的批次，返回药品名、批号、库存和有效期。
gold_sql: SELECT d.generic_name, i.batch_number, i.quantity_on_hand, i.expiry_date FROM inventory i JOIN drugs d ON i.drug_id = d.drug_id WHERE i.expiry_date < '2027-06-30' ORDER BY i.expiry_date, d.generic_name;

task: 统计每个治疗领域的药品数量、总库存和总销售额。
gold_sql: SELECT d.therapeutic_area, COUNT(DISTINCT d.drug_id) AS drug_count, SUM(i.quantity_on_hand) AS inventory_total, COALESCE(SUM(s.total_amount), 0) AS revenue FROM drugs d LEFT JOIN inventory i ON d.drug_id = i.drug_id LEFT JOIN sales_records s ON d.drug_id = s.drug_id GROUP BY d.therapeutic_area ORDER BY revenue DESC;
answer_checks: 统计药品数、库存、销售额
注意多表join导致重复计数风险

task: 查询心血管领域药品的销售明细，包含通用名、商品名、客户、区域、销售额。
gold_sql: SELECT d.generic_name, d.brand_name, s.customer_name, s.region, s.total_amount FROM drugs d JOIN sales_records s ON d.drug_id = s.drug_id WHERE d.therapeutic_area LIKE '%心血管%' ORDER BY s.total_amount DESC;

task: 哪些药品的库存总量低于 5000？请给出药品名、治疗领域、总库存。
gold_sql: SELECT d.generic_name, d.therapeutic_area, SUM(i.quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory FROM drugs d JOIN inventory i ON d.drug_id = i.drug_id GROUP BY d.drug_id, d.generic_name, d.therapeutic_area HAVING total_inventory < 5000 ORDER BY total_inventory ASC;
answer_checks: 不要将单批库存误当总库存

task: 找出平均销售单价最高的 10 个药品，返回通用名、平均单价和总销售额。
gold_sql: SELECT d.generic_name, AVG(s.unit_price) AS avg_unit_price, SUM(s.total_amount) AS revenue FROM drugs d JOIN sales_records s ON d.drug_id = s.drug_id GROUP BY d.drug_id, d.generic_name ORDER BY avg_unit_price DESC LIMIT 10;

task: 查询 2025 年下半年销售额高于 5 万元的销售记录，输出日期、药品、客户、区域、销售额。
gold_sql: SELECT s.sale_date, d.generic_name, s.customer_name, s.region, s.total_amount FROM sales_records s JOIN drugs d ON s.drug_id = d.drug_id WHERE s.sale_date >= '2025-07-01' AND s.sale_date <= '2025-12-31' AND s.total_amount > 50000 ORDER BY s.total_amount DESC;

task: 按月份统计 2025 年销售额走势，输出月份、销售额、销量。
gold_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(sale_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue, SUM(quantity_sold) AS quantity FROM sales_records GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

task: 查询每个仓库位置的库存总量，找出库存最多的 10 个仓库位置。
gold_sql: SELECT warehouse_location, SUM(quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory FROM inventory GROUP BY warehouse_location ORDER BY total_inventory DESC LIMIT 10;

task: 查询抗生素类药品的库存和销售表现，返回药品、库存总量、销售额。
gold_sql: SELECT d.generic_name, SUM(i.quantity_on_hand) AS inventory_total, SUM(s.total_amount) AS revenue FROM drugs d LEFT JOIN inventory i ON d.drug_id = i.drug_id LEFT JOIN sales_records s ON d.drug_id = s.drug_id WHERE d.therapeutic_area LIKE '%抗生素%' GROUP BY d.drug_id, d.generic_name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

task: 哪些客户的采购金额最高？返回前 10 个客户、区域和采购金额。
gold_sql: SELECT customer_name, region, SUM(total_amount) AS purchase_amount FROM sales_records GROUP BY customer_name, region ORDER BY purchase_amount DESC LIMIT 10;

task: 查找同时存在库存且有销售记录的药品数量。
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.drug_id) AS drug_count FROM drugs d JOIN inventory i ON d.drug_id = i.drug_id JOIN sales_records s ON d.drug_id = s.drug_id;

task: 查询每个销售代表负责的销售额，并按销售额降序排列。
gold_sql: SELECT sales_rep, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue, SUM(quantity_sold) AS quantity FROM sales_records GROUP BY sales_rep ORDER BY revenue DESC;

task: 找出销售额高但库存偏低的药品：总销售额超过 5 万且总库存低于 1 万。
gold_sql: SELECT d.generic_name, SUM(DISTINCT i.quantity_on_hand) AS inventory_total, SUM(s.total_amount) AS revenue FROM drugs d JOIN inventory i ON d.drug_id = i.drug_id JOIN sales_records s ON d.drug_id = s.drug_id GROUP BY d.drug_id, d.generic_name HAVING revenue > 50000 AND inventory_total < 10000 ORDER BY revenue DESC;
answer_checks: 同时判断销售额和库存

task: 列出所有剂型为注射剂的药品及其库存批次。
gold_sql: SELECT d.generic_name, d.brand_name, i.batch_number, i.quantity_on_hand, i.expiry_date FROM drugs d JOIN inventory i ON d.drug_id = i.drug_id WHERE d.dosage_form LIKE '%注射%' ORDER BY d.generic_name, i.expiry_date;
answer_checks: 不要查互联网药品资料

task: 计算每个药品的库存周转粗略指标：2025 年销量 / 当前库存总量，返回前 10 个最高的药品。
gold_sql: SELECT d.generic_name, SUM(s.quantity_sold) AS sold_qty, inv.inventory_total, SUM(s.quantity_sold) / inv.inventory_total AS turnover_ratio FROM drugs d JOIN sales_records s ON d.drug_id = s.drug_id JOIN (SELECT drug_id, SUM(quantity_on_hand) AS inventory_total FROM inventory GROUP BY drug_id) inv ON d.drug_id = inv.drug_id GROUP BY d.drug_id, d.generic_name, inv.inventory_total ORDER BY turnover_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
answer_checks: 先聚合库存再计算比率

task: 查询全国区域销售记录的药品、客户、销售额，并说明这类记录是否应单独处理。
gold_sql: SELECT d.generic_name, s.customer_name, s.total_amount FROM sales_records s JOIN drugs d ON s.drug_id = d.drug_id WHERE s.region = '全国' ORDER BY s.total_amount DESC;
answer_checks: 可说明全国汇总口径不应直接归属单一区域

task: 查询品牌名、通用名或说明中包含“感冒”的药品，并返回其销售额。
gold_sql: SELECT d.generic_name, d.brand_name, d.therapeutic_area, COALESCE(SUM(s.total_amount), 0) AS revenue FROM drugs d LEFT JOIN sales_records s ON d.drug_id = s.drug_id WHERE d.generic_name LIKE '%感冒%' OR d.brand_name LIKE '%感冒%' OR d.description LIKE '%感冒%' OR d.therapeutic_area LIKE '%感冒%' GROUP BY d.drug_id, d.generic_name, d.brand_name, d.therapeutic_area ORDER BY revenue DESC;
